title: How to make or find battlebacks for 1280 x 720 resolution?

posts.author: Darkmoon9
posts.body: Hi, after making the switch to 1280 x720 resolution, I have found most of my battlebacks are too small for the screen. Do anyone know how to find battlebacks for higher resolution or how to convert existing battlebacks to it the wider screen?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: You could just upscale the existing ones to fit 1280? This will result in them going off screen top and bottom, but there's so much dead space usually that it hardly matter. You can then of course also go and cut off the excess if you wanted to.
